title: Three Springs and One Short Plan
subtitle: 人生规划 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人生规划（人与自我·生活与学习·未来与规划）
meta: 主题语境：人生规划（人与自我·生活与学习·未来与规划）　|　核心词汇：future　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 future 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my uncle ① planned a future that no teacher in the school would have named, and he said the planning was the whole of the spring. The ② future, meaning the time itself and not the day, ran three springs and stayed unnamed in the book; a future, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ future in that school had the same short note beside it, and the ④ future at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A future, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my uncle said the naming is the part that fills three springs.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the future was the whole of the matter, meaning the prospect and not the time. The ⑥ future, meaning the prospect and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; future, she said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both a time and a prospect. She said the prospect is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ future had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ future of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in April, was one school and three springs of naming; future, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ future I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ future, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being named; every future, she said, is a prospect that has agreed to look like a time. She said the prospect was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 将来；未来（指学校里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 未来（指那一时段本身，与眼下的日子相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan a future 规划一个未来
D. n. 未来（指留给孩子们的那一个）
E. n. 未来（抽象总称，指一所学校的规划之事）
F. n. 未来（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个）
G. n. 前途；前程（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 前途（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

answers.why: plan a future 意为“规划一个未来”，1966 年叔叔规划了一个学校里没有一位老师肯说出名字的未来。
future 意为“未来”，指那一时段本身而不是眼下的日子，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
future 意为“未来”，指学校里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
future 意为“未来”，指留给孩子们的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
future 意为“前途、前程”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，姑姑说这份前程就是那件事的全部。
future 意为“前途”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那个未来，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
future 意为“未来”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了计划里的一行。
future 意为“未来”，叔叔四月写道，整件事的规划之事是一所学校和三个春天的说出名字。
future 意为“未来”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一个，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一个。
future 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，一个未来是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
